# Built-in extractors

The extractors built into the CLI, in the order it lists them. A projection names one in `extractor`; any program
can be an extractor instead (see [Write your first extractor](../guides/first-extractor.md)).
`projections extractor list --json` prints this catalog as JSON.

An input that names a file, folder or glob the examined revision doesn't have (a revision before it was added, or after
it was removed) isn't an error: the extractor describes that revision without it and lists it in the extraction's
`missingInputs`, so a comparison shows its contents as added or removed, with a notice (see
[Output](../runner/commands.md#output)). One that exists but can't be parsed still fails, and so does
`projections check`.

| Extractor | Schema | Default renderer | Needs `--trust` |
|---|---|---|---|
| [`workspace-dependencies`](#workspace-dependencies) | `graph/v0` | `dependencies` | No (`none`) |
| [`repository-map`](#repository-map) | `graph/v0` | `file-packing` | No (`none`) |
| [`typescript-public-api`](#typescript-public-api) | `api/v0` | `api` | No (`none`) |

## `workspace-dependencies`

**Workspace dependencies.** Node workspace packages, declared dependency ranges and lockfile resolutions for npm, pnpm and Yarn. See [its page](../builtins/extractors/workspace-dependencies.md).

- Schema: `graph/v0`
- Default renderer: `dependencies`
- Needs `--trust`: No (`none`)

| Input | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `packageManager` | npm, pnpm or yarn; default from package.json packageManager or the lockfile present. |
| `root` | Repository-relative workspace root; default ".". |

A definition to start from:

```json
{
  "extractor": "workspace-dependencies",
  "id": "workspace-dependencies",
  "renderer": "dependencies",
  "title": "Workspace dependencies"
}
```

## `repository-map`

**Repository map.** Tracked and untracked nonignored file hierarchy. See [its page](../builtins/extractors/repository-map.md).

- Schema: `graph/v0`
- Default renderer: `file-packing`
- Needs `--trust`: No (`none`)

| Input | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `exclude` | Array of globs to skip. |
| `include` | Array of globs to map; default every file. |
| `lines` | Boolean; also count the lines of each text file (default false). |

A definition to start from:

```json
{
  "extractor": "repository-map",
  "id": "repository-map",
  "renderer": "file-packing",
  "title": "Repository map"
}
```

## `rust-public-api`

**Rust public API.** rustdoc JSON public items. See [its page](../builtins/extractors/rust-public-api.md).

- Schema: `api/v0`
- Default renderer: `api`
- Needs `--trust`: When it runs ecosystem tools or repository code (`when-executing-tools`)

| Input | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `allFeatures` | Enable every feature. |
| `cargoPath` | Cargo executable. |
| `features` | Features to enable. |
| `manifestPath` | Cargo.toml path; default Cargo.toml. |
| `noDefaultFeatures` | Disable default features. |
| `package` | Package to document in a workspace. |
| `rustdocJson` | Pre-generated rustdoc JSON file; otherwise runs cargo rustdoc. |
| `toolchain` | rustup toolchain with rustdoc JSON, such as a pinned nightly. |

A definition to start from:

```json
{
  "extractor": "rust-public-api",
  "id": "rust-public-api",
  "inputs": {
    "toolchain": "nightly"
  },
  "renderer": "api",
  "title": "Rust public API"
}
```

## `terraform-infrastructure`

**Terraform infrastructure.** Terraform resources, modules and references, with each resource's planned action. See [its page](../builtins/extractors/terraform-infrastructure.md).

- Schema: `architecture/v0`
- Default renderer: `infrastructure`
- Needs `--trust`: When it runs ecosystem tools or repository code (`when-executing-tools`)

| Input | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `directory` | Terraform working directory to plan when neither file is given (requires --trust; default: the repository root). |
| `planArguments` | Extra `terraform plan` arguments, for example ["-var-file=prod.tfvars"]. |
| `planJsonPath` | Pre-exported `terraform show -json` of a saved plan (or of the state); read without running Terraform. |
| `planPath` | Saved binary plan, read with `terraform show -json` (requires --trust). |
| `terraformPath` | Terraform (or OpenTofu) executable; default `terraform`. |

A definition to start from:

```json
{
  "extractor": "terraform-infrastructure",
  "id": "terraform-infrastructure",
  "inputs": {
    "planJsonPath": ".projections/inputs/terraform.json"
  },
  "renderer": "infrastructure",
  "title": "Terraform infrastructure"
}
```

## `azure-what-if`

**Azure infrastructure.** Azure resources, containment and references, with each resource's what-if change. See [its page](../builtins/extractors/azure-what-if.md).

- Schema: `architecture/v0`
- Default renderer: `infrastructure`
- Needs `--trust`: When it runs ecosystem tools or repository code (`when-executing-tools`)

| Input | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `azPath` | Azure CLI executable; default `az`. |
| `location` | Deployment location (scopes sub, mg and tenant). |
| `managementGroupId` | Management group (scope mg). |
| `mode` | Incremental (default) or Complete (scope group). |
| `parameters` | Parameter files (repository-relative) or name=value pairs. |
| `resourceGroup` | Resource group (scope group). |
| `scope` | Deployment scope for templateFile: group (default), sub, mg or tenant. |
| `subscription` | Subscription name or ID; default the CLI's current subscription. |
| `templateFile` | Bicep or ARM template to run what-if for (requires --trust and an Azure CLI login). |
| `templateJsonPath` | Optional compiled ARM template (`bicep build` output) whose dependsOn adds dependencies. |
| `whatIfJsonPath` | Pre-exported `az deployment … what-if --no-pretty-print` result; read without running Azure CLI. |

A definition to start from:

```json
{
  "extractor": "azure-what-if",
  "id": "azure-what-if",
  "inputs": {
    "whatIfJsonPath": ".projections/inputs/what-if.json"
  },
  "renderer": "infrastructure",
  "title": "Azure infrastructure"
}
```

## `github-agentic-workflows`

**Agentic workflows.** GitHub Agentic Workflows: what starts each one, its engine, tools and their scope, network, permissions, safe outputs, budgets and imports, and whether its lock file is current. See [its page](../builtins/extractors/github-agentic-workflows.md).

- Schema: `architecture/v0`
- Default renderer: `agentic-workflows`
- Needs `--trust`: No (`none`)

| Input | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `classes` | An object of class name (such as guardrail) to globs of import paths and skill references; the comparator warns when a classified import or skill is removed. |
| `exclude` | Array of globs to skip. |
| `groups` | "prefix" to group each workflow with the workflows named after it and a dash, or an object of group name to globs of workflow paths or names. |
| `paths` | Array of globs selecting workflow markdown; default .github/workflows/*.md. Files without `on` (shared components) and README.md are skipped. |

A definition to start from:

```json
{
  "extractor": "github-agentic-workflows",
  "id": "github-agentic-workflows",
  "renderer": "agentic-workflows",
  "title": "Agentic workflows"
}
```

## `tetragon-policies`

**Runtime security policies.** Kernel and user-space hooks that Tetragon tracing policies observe or enforce, with their conditions and the workloads they apply to. See [its page](../builtins/extractors/tetragon-policies.md).

- Schema: `architecture/v0`
- Default renderer: `runtime-policy`
- Needs `--trust`: When it runs ecosystem tools or repository code (`when-executing-tools`)

| Input | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `agentValuesPath` | The Tetragon Helm chart values file the repository deploys the agent with. |
| `crdPath` | A file, or array of files, holding the TracingPolicy CRDs the repository deploys; policies are checked against them. |
| `exclude` | Array of globs to skip. |
| `helm` | {chart, values?, releaseName?, namespace?, helmPath?}: render a chart in the repository with helm template (requires trust). |
| `kernelProfilesPath` | A YAML or JSON file of kernel profiles ({profiles: [{name, kernel?, config?, symbols?, errorInjection?}]}) of the nodes policies load on. |
| `kustomize` | {path, kustomizePath?}: render a kustomization in the repository with kustomize build (requires trust). |
| `namespace` | Namespace for TracingPolicyNamespaced resources and workloads that name none. |
| `paths` | Array of globs selecting YAML files to read; default every .yaml and .yml file (none when helm or kustomize is set). Files that don't mention TracingPolicy are skipped. |
| `renderedManifestsPath` | A file of already rendered manifests (for example helm template output from CI) to read instead of paths. |
| `workloadPaths` | Array of globs selecting Kubernetes workload manifests, to show which policies cover which workloads. |

A definition to start from:

```json
{
  "extractor": "tetragon-policies",
  "id": "tetragon-policies",
  "inputs": {
    "paths": [
      "**/*.yaml",
      "**/*.yml"
    ]
  },
  "renderer": "runtime-policy",
  "title": "Runtime security policies"
}
```

| `tsconfig` | tsconfig.json path; default the nearest to the root module. |

A definition to start from:

```json
{
  "extractor": "nestjs-di",
  "id": "nestjs-di",
  "renderer": "dependency-injection",
  "title": "NestJS dependency injection"
}
```

**SCIP file references.** Cross-file definition references from a SCIP index produced by the project's own indexer. See [its page](../builtins/extractors/scip-file-references.md).

- Default renderer: `graph`

| Input | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `index` | Repository-relative SCIP index to read instead of running an indexer; it must match the revision. |
| `indexer` | SCIP indexer argv run at each revision, such as ["scip-typescript","index","--output","{output}"]; {output} names a private index path, otherwise the indexer writes index.scip in its working directory. Requires --trust. |
| `root` | Repository-relative directory the indexer runs in and the index's document paths are relative to; default ".". |

A definition to start from:

```json
{
  "extractor": "scip-file-references",
  "id": "scip-file-references",
  "inputs": {
    "indexer": [
      "scip-typescript",
      "index",
      "--output",
      "{output}"
    ]
  },
  "renderer": "graph",
  "title": "SCIP file references"
}
```

## `command-output`

**Command output.** Captured stdout from named CLI commands. See [its page](../builtins/extractors/command-output.md).

- Schema: `graph/v0`
- Default renderer: `text-diff`
- Needs `--trust`: When it runs ecosystem tools or repository code (`when-executing-tools`)

| Input | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `commands` | Array of {id, label, command} with stable ID and executable argv; each command runs in both revisions (requires --trust). |

A definition to start from:

```json
{
  "extractor": "command-output",
  "id": "command-output",
  "renderer": "text-diff",
  "title": "Command output"
}
```
